chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman who had a slave husband, so she inherited him and emancipated him: Would they remain upon their first marriage? He said: No, but they must renew with another marriage.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife's emancipation of her inherited slave husband dissolve their existing marriage contract?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the principle that the master-slave bond (mudiyyah) is a distinct legal category that, upon inheritance and emancipation, dissolves the existing marital contract. Consequently, to maintain the union, the couple must execute a new nikah with fresh consent, reflecting the shift from a hierarchical relationship to one of equals. This underscores the Shia juristic view that emancipation alters the fundamental legal status of the parties, necessitating a renewal of the marital bond.
